body:
Review read of head `008c96260` (read-only Opus agent that did not write the change, nothing built). **Result: the case is in good order; two changes of text are necessary before the review can be clean.** The independent run is in progress.

### What is correct

- The file set, `case.toml` and the README have the shape of `2d/first-part`. The model is original: an analytic spherical cap on a plate, made by a script that uses only `math` and `sys`; two runs of the script give the committed `.obj` byte for byte.
- **The posted program.** Start and end are those of `first-part`. Feeds are 1200 / 1500 for the cut and 300 for the plunge; no feed is zero. The smallest Z of the full program is Z8.0, the top of the plate, for each of the three operations: the tool does not go below the part. Against the mesh the two finishes are within -0.013 mm (inside the tolerance of 0.1 mm): no gouge. In the two finishes each rapid is at Z47. The roughing levels are Z20 to Z8 in steps of 2 mm, each with a helix at its start. The Waterline finish is not empty (2077 cutting moves in rings from Z17.9 to Z8).
- The tests have the shape of their neighbours and stay in the `example_catalog` binary. The two doc blocks are in the generator markers. No stray file. `git merge-tree` with main is clean.

### Necessary (text only)

1. **The README says something that is not true.** Lines 10-11 and 23-24 say that the roughing "leaves 0.5 mm of stock on the dome and the plate". The program leaves 0 mm at the apex of the dome (the level at Z18 passes 0.0006 mm from the apex), 0 mm on the plate (the last level is Z8), and 0.21 mm to 0.38 mm on the flanks. Say what the program does, and link #3669.
2. **#2866 asks that each wrong output that the case shows is filed as a bug and linked on #2392.** The read found three in the 3D Pocket roughing; the coordinator filed them: #3669 (the stock to leave is applied only sideways), #3670 (a re-entry in a level is a straight plunge into stock although the entry is a helix), #3671 (the rapid between levels goes down to the last cut floor with no margin). Name the three in the README ("What to look at") and in the PR body, and comment the three links on #2392. The pinned program stays as it is: it shows the behaviour of today, and each fix makes it again.

### Small

3. The body has `Changelog: none`; the catalog case PR #2877 had an `Examples:` row and the type `docs(examples)`. Follow that PR.
4. `example_catalog.rs` goes from 404 to 405 lines (it was above 400 before).

No product code changes are necessary in this PR.

Independent run of head `008c96260` on a merge with main `7227d52fa` (and again on main `67e9ebd41` with #3500): **all gate steps green.** `cargo xtask catalog --check`: 15 cases green. `example_catalog`: 39 passed, 4 ignored; the two tests of the new case take 28.7 s and 28.1 s (budget 60 s), and pass again on a second run. `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`, `first_part_programs`, `golden_cl` 34, `conformance` 7, `docs_troubleshooting`: green. `cargo test -p xtask catalog`: green. The site tests `test_guide_refresh`, `test_release_022_guide`, `test_release_026_guide`: green. The model script writes the committed `.obj` byte for byte. `test_guide_icons` fails on `main` too (a site icon from #3058 is missing; new issue filed): not caused by this PR. The two text items of the review read stay open; the author's agent has them.

Addressed: the README now says what the roughing leaves (0 mm at the apex and on the plate, 0.21 to 0.38 mm on the flanks) and links #3669, #3670 and #3671. The PR body names the three bugs and has an `Examples:` changelog row. The title type is now `docs(examples)`, as in PR #2877. A comment on #2392 links the bugs. Text only: no build, because no test reads the README text. Head `7586baac5` (after a plain merge of main).

<!-- pr-reviewer: 7586baac507a69e6e3761ff8c30297c0398118ef -->
**Review of head `7586baac5`: clean.** The change request on `008c96260` ends with this review. The read is in the comment above (a read-only Opus agent that did not write the change); a gate-runner that did not write the change ran the case.

- **Delta `008c96260..7586baac5`:** one file, the README of the case (+19/-4), and merges of main with an empty remerge diff. The coordinator read the new text in the author's report: it says what the roughing leaves (0 mm at the apex of the dome and on the plate, 0.21 mm to 0.38 mm on the flanks) and names the three bugs that the case shows (#3669, #3670, #3671). #2392 has the three links. The body has the `Examples:` row.
- **Independent run** of `008c96260` on main `7227d52fa` and again on main `67e9ebd41`: `cargo xtask catalog --check` green for 15 cases; `example_catalog` 39 passed (the two new tests about 28 s each, stable on a second run); `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`, `first_part_programs`, `golden_cl`, `conformance`, `docs_troubleshooting`, the `xtask` catalog tests and three site tests: green. The model script writes the committed model byte for byte. No test reads the text of the README.
- Main `67e9ebd41` is an ancestor of this head.

The pinned program shows the behaviour of 3D Pocket today, with the three open bugs. Each fix makes the program again.
